prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1286; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good morning. This is the adjuster following up on your claim. This recorded statement is for the file. Do you understand and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand and I consent.

Q: Please state the location where the collision occurred.

A: It was on a two-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center entrance.

Q: Can you describe how the collision happened?

A: I was driving my car in my lane heading toward the intersection. The other vehicle came over into my lane and we hit head-on. It wasn't a hard impact, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: What was your approximate speed at the time?

A: I'd say maybe fifteen or twenty miles per hour. I was slowing down because of traffic ahead.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: No, they did not.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They said I had a back strain and gave me some medication and told me to rest.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes, I have lower back stiffness, mostly in the morning, and some soreness when I bend or lift things.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries or treatment to your back?

A: No, nothing significant. I've had occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing that required a doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm still working with my doctor and I'll send over any records I receive.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
